fusions.name: Pull Taut
fusions.desc: Yanks a tether of arcana on a target up to 7 tiles away, dealing 18 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and slowing it by 20% for 2 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Fettering Current
fusions.desc: Throws a bolt of lightning that deals 12 damage and stuns the first enemy it meets for 1 second, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Shocked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hold Fast
fusions.desc: After a 0.5 second cast, binds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Link by Link
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (218% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
